aside.label: A host looking for a sponsor? Tell us about your nights

to.message: Hi {{brand.name}}, I host events and I’m looking for a brand sponsor. Here’s what I run:

sections.title: Run it yourself, or back the hosts who already do.

items.title: Run community nights under your brand
items.body: A page for your brand, events in each city, applications or paid booking, the door and the follow-up.

items.title: Back run clubs, supper clubs and quiz nights
items.body: Hosts run the night on {{brand.name}}; you give each one a link and see what your partnership brought.
list: A link per partner host and creator

sections.title: Every partner, measured the same way.
sections.lead: Give every host, creator, store and post its own link. {{brand.name}} follows each one from the first visit to a booking and to the door.
ticks: Visits, bookings and attendance for every link
Repeat guests, not just first visits
One report across cities and partners

sections.title: Reach without overreach.
sections.lead: You see counts and outcomes for every partner. Contact details come only from people who said yes to hearing from your brand.

items.title: Aggregate reports by default
items.body: Bookings, attendance and repeats by partner.

items.title: Hosts keep their guests
items.body: A partnership never moves a host’s list to you.

items.title: Private links for launches
items.body: Invite-only events stay off public pages.

sections.title: of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 per billing cycle.
sections.trial: The same 5% and the same cap as every host. Free events stay free. Payment gateway fees are separate. Multi-city series and programmes: ask for a walkthrough and we’ll plan it with you.

to.message: Hi {{brand.name}}, I’d like a walkthrough for a brand series across cities.

items.question: Can we see the guests partner hosts bring?
items.answer: You see counts: bookings, attendance and repeat guests by partner. Names and contact details only come from people who opted in to hear from your brand.

items.question: Can we run events in several cities?
items.answer: Yes. Each city’s events sit on your brand page, and the report rolls them up.

items.question: Can we keep a launch invite-only?
items.answer: Yes. Invite-only events stay off public pages; only people with your link can book.

items.question: How do we find hosts to partner with?
items.answer: Ask us for a walkthrough on WhatsApp and tell us the cities and formats you want. We’ll introduce hosts who fit.

items.question: Do guests need an app?
items.answer: No. Guests book and check in in their phone’s browser.
